context.skin_label: Vertical pan down the tool, sticky caption pinned to the top

video_prompt: A 30-second vertical social promo for ToolsRift's Payslip Generator. The video uses a before-after emotional angle, targeting business owners and HR managers who need clean payroll documents. At 0s, the hook shows a blank document. At 5s, the video cuts to a screen recording of the payslip generator in action, showing live editing of earnings and deductions. At 16s, the benefits are displayed on screen. At 23s, the final call to action appears. The visual style features smooth vertical pans down the browser interface, with clean UI typography and a persistent caption pinned to the top.

vo.text: Struggling to format a professional salary slip from scratch?
Fill in the employee details and watch the totals calculate instantly.
Choose from five currencies and switch your number formatting system automatically.
Create your free payslip right now at ToolsRift dot com.

on_screen.hook: Stop wasting time on payroll formatting
on_screen.caption: Gross and net pay calculate automatically.

editorial: The tool handles complex regional requirements by automatically switching amount-in-words formatting between the international billion system and the Indian lakh system based on your currency selection.

broll.image_prompt: Minimalist minimalist desk setup with a laptop displaying a blank document, soft morning light, clean corporate aesthetic, no text, no faces
broll.motion_prompt: Slow continuous zoom in towards the center of the desk

broll.image_prompt: Abstract close up of glowing digital interface lines and grid patterns, modern UI design elements, clean dark mode, no text
broll.motion_prompt: Smooth vertical pan downward across the geometric lines

music_prompt: A smooth and minimal lofi electronic instrumental bed with a steady mid-tempo beat, warm synth pads, and no competing melodic hooks.
